title: So who is this Anton?
paragraphs: As I mentioned earlier, my name is Anton. I am a 31 year old student at Chas Academy studying Full Stack Development with a focus on the .NET framework. I have a background in studying and working in industrial design, logistics and project management.
Since a few years back I started finding programming with Python not only useful in my work but also fun and rewarding in my free time.
I soon realised I might have stumbled upon a new passion and decided to take a leap and start studying this new thing while working part time.
But hey, enough about that, more about me hehe.

I am currently living with my lovely fiancée in the beautiful city of Västerås. My free time is usually filled with doing weird sports with my friends. I have since a few years back been a below average golfer and disc golfer, an amateur boulderer and a pretty mediocre skateboarder. I love trying new things and doing them with the people I love.

But Im not only into moving my slightly below average body. I also have a passion for food and drinks. Me and a friend have been homebrewing beer for a few years and I have to say we are getting pretty good at it. I also spend a silly amount of time watching movies, playing videogames with friends and listening to music.
